title: Agentic research (composition entry point)
description: The motivating composition: a mention asks for research, the flow calls the callable ensure-capacity sub-flow and WAITS for its output (composition depth 1, budget-guarded), then assigns the research capability on the capacity that just landed. The invoke's timeout is the age law (guard 4): a stalled child is cancelled with its subtree, this flow takes its failed edge.

Assign the research work on the capacity that landed
Capacity never landed: say so in the thread
